description:
[read-only] Posting (drip) queues of one brand. A queue posts one item every cadenceHours at timeOfDay in its timezone, keeping `lookahead` items booked at the platform.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/queues.)

brandId.description: Account-wide keys: "personal" or an id from GET /api/v2/brands (omitted → the brand last active in the dashboard). A brand-bound key always uses its own brand.

name: list_queues
title: List posting queues
